input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
input.rationale: Arizona law is outside our accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales), and there is no venue clause — disputes instead go to mandatory binding arbitration under private rules (§19). Redline moves governing law and exclusive venue to New York; the arbitration seat is at least domestic, so this is not walk-away, but the choice of law must change.

input.quote: 10. NONASSIGNABILITY. Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: A blanket mutual consent requirement with no affiliate or M&A/successor carve-out for Company falls short of the fallback (right to assign to successors on written notice) and is squarely in walk-away territory for us. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out and confirms a change of control gives Contractor no termination or re-pricing right, leaving the reasonable-consent standard intact for other assignments.
